headings.usage: Use for all H1-H3. Tight tracking (-0.02em). Strict hierarchy.

body.usage: High legibility for course content and dashboards.

mono.usage: For schedule time slots and data tables.

colors.note: ALL colors must be implemented as CSS variables to support Admin Panel customization.

primary.description: Deep Royal Blue. Trust, Authority, Education.

accent.description: Academic Red. Use sparingly for 'British Council' association and critical alerts.

surface.description: Very light gray for dashboard sections and cards.

public_marketing.alignment: Left-aligned headings for serious tone, centered only for specific call-outs.

dashboard.navigation: Sidebar for Admin/Student, Topbar for common actions.
dashboard.card_style: Flat, 1px border (border-gray-200), no shadow or very subtle shadow-sm.

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Solid primary color.
buttons.text: Uppercase + Tracking-wide for CTA, Normal for UI actions.

cards.style: Clean white, 1px border. No heavy shadows.

forms.style: Shadcn defaults with rounded-md. Focus ring must match --primary.

schedule_builder.visuals: Time grid. Conflict slots highlighted in red/accent.

hero_background.usage: Main Landing Page Hero. Use with dark overlay (bg-black/50) for text readability.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain on marketing backgrounds to reduce sterility.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very minimal. Preference for borders over shadows for the 'strict' look.

admin_customization_rules.logo: Must be editable via Admin Settings. Use a placeholder initially.
admin_customization_rules.colors: Admin saves Hex codes -> System updates CSS Variables (:root).
admin_customization_rules.texts: All landing page text content must be fetched from DB/API.

universal_guidelines: Use CSS variables for all colors to enable Admin Theme Customization.
Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds, keep it flat and serious.
Ensure high contrast (WCAG AA) for all text.
Dashboard must support Multi-Branch data isolation visually (e.g., branch name in header).
Schedule Builder must clearly show conflicts (Red background for busy slots).
Public pages must be fully responsive (Mobile First).
